title: Email inbox gets folders, read state, and a recoverable trash
summary: Email threads now have a folder and a read state, a trashed thread can be restored, and replies can add their own Cc and Bcc recipients.
body_markdown:
Email conversations move from a single` labels` list to dedicated` folder` and` read` fields.[Get](https://bird.com/docs/api/reference/get-email-thread) ,[list](https://bird.com/docs/api/reference/list-email-threads) , and[update a thread](https://bird.com/docs/api/reference/update-email-thread) now return` folder` (` inbox` ,` archive` ,` spam` ,` blocked` ,` sent` , or` trash` ) and` read` , with` labels` reserved for your own custom tags. List threads by folder with` folder=` , filter by read state with` read_state=read|unread` , and match custom labels with` labels=` .


Trash is no longer a dead end:` DELETE` moves a conversation's messages to trash, and the new[restore a thread](https://bird.com/docs/api/reference/restore-email-thread) endpoint (` POST /v1/email/threads/{thread_id}/restore` ) brings back whatever hasn't passed its trash deadline or the mailbox's retention period, with folder, read state, and labels intact.


Also in this release:


- **Replies can add their own Cc and Bcc.**[Reply to a thread message](https://bird.com/docs/api/reference/reply-email-thread-message) now accepts` cc` and` bcc` on top of` reply_all` , each capped at 50 merged addresses. Bcc recipients stay out of conversation participants and visible headers, and their delivery outcomes are excluded from the sent message's per-recipient` recipients` list, which now only tracks the To and Cc lines.
- **Mailboxes split sender name from dashboard name.**[Create](https://bird.com/docs/api/reference/create-mailbox) and[update a mailbox](https://bird.com/docs/api/reference/update-mailbox) take a` name` field for the sender name shown on outgoing mail;` display_name` is now what your team sees in the dashboard and defaults to` name` when no override is set.
- **Number ownership status explains unrecoverable cases.**[Get](https://bird.com/docs/api/reference/get-workspace-number) and[list workspace numbers](https://bird.com/docs/api/reference/list-workspace-numbers) can now return` ownership.unavailable_at` for a number that can't be activated and` ownership.registration_due_at` , the deadline for completing ownership details before a number is removed.
- **WhatsApp template language pages link straight to Meta.**[Get a template version language](https://bird.com/docs/api/reference/get-whatsapp-template-version-language) adds` whatsapp_manager_url` , a direct link into Meta's WhatsApp Manager for that language.
